epics.title: Implementation Plan: Account and Contact Management
epics.notes: Stand up the Account and Contact CRUD HTTP surface -- the master-data foundation of mock-salesforce -- backed by a fresh SQLite schema, with full validation, error-shaping, and delete-guard behavior per the Live Spec.

epics.title: Implementation Plan: Opportunity Lifecycle CRUD
epics.notes: Add the full Opportunity CRUD HTTP surface, including the stage-transition endpoint, on top of the existing Account/Contact scaffold.

epics.title: Health route, static asset hosting, and OpenAPI contract
epics.notes: Add GET /health with no DB dependency, conditional static asset hosting for crm-ui's build output at GET /, and confirm GET /openapi.json reflects all mounted routes.

epics.title: Pipeline board view, account switcher
epics.notes: All 7 plan tasks implemented and reviewed; spec status implemented

epics.notes: All 12 plan tasks implemented and reviewed

epics.title: Deal detail page and CRUD forms
Account and Contact MCP tools
epics.notes: Stand up the mcp-server module exposing all 10 Account/Contact CRUD operations as MCP tools over Streamable HTTP transport, wrapping crm-api's HTTP endpoints with schema validation, verbatim error passthrough, and clear connection-error handling.

epics.title: Implementation Plan: Opportunity MCP tools
epics.notes: Add the 5 Opportunity MCP tools (list/get/create/update/delete_opportunity) to the mcp-server module, wrapping crm-api's Opportunity endpoints including stage_name transitions and account_id/stage_name list filters.

epics.title: Docker packaging and run instructions
epics.notes: Package crm-api (bundling crm-ui's static assets) and mcp-server into two Docker images wired by docker-compose.yml, with a named volume for SQLite, PORT-driven remapping, and written run instructions.
